title: A Deterministic Two-Layer Interpretation of DNA
abstract: DNA's readable layer can be read completely and mechanically: from sequence alone one deterministic engine reads any locus the same way — material γ, the A4 coordinate, the R19 switch — to a sharp, enumerated boundary (size, sign, dosage, timing are runtime). Across the tree of life γ is near-invariant among master switches (corr(γ,GC)=0.998, CV 0.1–2%), so taxa differ not in the material but in four readable operations the reading exposes. Every read graded; present-tense only.

chapters.title: The reading, stated plainly
chapters.one_liner: DNA's readable layer is read completely and mechanically; readability ends at a sharp, enumerated boundary (calibration or out-of-scope, no fourth bucket).

chapters.title: How to read a locus
chapters.one_liner: The method end-to-end on human_SOX2 (γ=1.287315): γ→threshold scale, the A4 coordinate, R19 can-fire, the five channels of one read.

chapters.title: The DNA Dictionary
chapters.one_liner: Engine-generated lexicon over 26 curated loci (γ 1.264–1.444, all R19-bistable) with its own gate — a Dictionary of reads, not traits.

chapters.title: Constitution and scope
chapters.one_liner: What this framework reads (γ + coordinates, present-tense only), its admissibility rule, and its relation to evolution and the origin of life.

chapters.title: Material (γ): the threshold scale
chapters.one_liner: γ barely separates taxa: cross-species CV 0.1–2%, corr(γ,GC)=0.998, warm-blooded genes at the same γ as cold-blooded. A threshold scale, not the locus.

chapters.title: Set: the switch inventory
chapters.one_liner: Deep splits are read in the inventory: a vertebrate reads 3+ OTX switches, an invertebrate 1, under one grammar. The difference is the count, not the material.

chapters.title: State: a switch on or off
chapters.one_liner: With the inventory shared, a trait is present only if its switch is on: snake ZRS is off at the same γ as human (1.290 vs 1.264). γ is blind to on/off.

chapters.title: Dwell: how long the switch runs
chapters.one_liner: Master-gene γ is invariant across ~10^5× mass (CV 0.5%), so size is not in the material — it is dwell × dosage at runtime. Direction admissible, absolute open.

chapters.title: Environment: the drive h
chapters.one_liner: The environment never rewrites the genome; it sets h via methylation (CpG handles 11–179) and temperature (fixed γ, flip ×4) within a fixed SET. Reversible.

chapters.title: Cases by register
chapters.one_liner: Every verified case re-homed under one primary register with its measured anchor and status — zero re-interpretation.

chapters.title: Bounds, open questions, retired claims
chapters.one_liner: The standing reference: what γ does and does not do, the consolidated failure log, the open register, and the irreversible retired register.

chapters.title: Environment as a methylation layer
chapters.one_liner: Lactase persistence is not a difference in the lactase gene's material: the LCT promoter reads the same γ in human and mouse, with |Δγ| = 0.034.

chapters.title: The lactase three-layer stack
chapters.one_liner: The lactase locus interpreted across three layers, material γ, methylation, and 3D structure, leaves no silent gray zone.

chapters.title: Cross-kingdom universality stress test
chapters.one_liner: The material γ tracks GC in every kingdom but is not taxon-invariant (CV 5.8%); CpG O/E splits methylating from non-methylating clades.

chapters.title: Clade-specific methylation readers
chapters.one_liner: Methylation has three architectures: plants read CG, CHG and CHH in bulk; insects need per-gene resolution for targeted gene-body methylation; an auto-detector routes each.

chapters.title: Unified deterministic interpreter
chapters.one_liner: γ and the A4 coordinate are the level and the shape of one stiffness field (A4 = the same signal with γ’s mean removed); one engine reads both, restores the coordinate, and corrects the global helical claim to an anchor-relative contact read.

appendices.title: The blueprint close-out: the jitter floor closed by one cited source-fix, the cis-drive shown data-blocked by measurement
appendices.one_liner: Appendix K closed the global zero-point (B1) and left a binding BLUEPRINT with two open items, one permanent ceiling, and one declared scope. This appendix takes the blueprint to its honest terminus — closing what can be closed and naming exactly what is missing where it cannot, add-only on the identical 63-gene atlas (all 63 driver-γ re-checked digit-for-digit against the parent App. K param_db, 0 mismatches; NO new γ). B4 JITTER FLOOR — CLOSED by one cited edge. In App. K, PAX7 was an artificial cascade source (indegree 0, depth 0) despite Carnegie rank 4, dragging the ±1 rank-jitter lower edge below the pre-registered 0.70 strength floor. The single cited edge MEOX1→PAX7 (somite/dermomyotome precedes & gives rise to Pax7⁺ myogenic progenitors; Buckingham & Relaix 2007, Mankoo 1999) — the same source-fix class already used for the limb/Hox founders — removes the artifact: Spearman(depth, Carnegie) 0.755→0.858; jitter p5 0.625→0.728 (≥ floor); frac≥floor 0.44→0.99; 0 new inversions (MEOX1 rank 4 = PAX7 rank 4, a concordant tie); DAG preserved. The strength is now jitter-robust but stays [L], NEVER [V] (the gate fails closed on promotion — B3 forbids a verified absolute strength). B2 CIS→DRIVE — DATA-BLOCKED by measurement. A deterministic, parameter-free probe (seed 19, 500 dinucleotide-shuffles, both strands) scans each child promoter — the same ±2 kb window the γ operator reads — for the parent regulator's cited consensus motif vs a shuffle null: only 5/21 both-cached edges exceed background, mean z 0.82, and decisively the canonical SOX9⊣RUNX2 edge is BELOW background (z=−2.13), consistent with that repression acting through distal enhancers, not the proximal promoter. The per-edge drive is not in the measured window; closing B2 needs distal-enhancer + chromatin-accessibility sequence the kit lacks — named as the unblock condition. W=√γ stays [F], not [L]. The whole inherited apparatus (DAG, wavefront & quorum theorems, sequence-drive, strength floor, sub-clock, two-anchor absolute clock) is re-audited byte-for-byte on the B4-extended cascade. GRADES: B4 jitter floor [L] closed (never [V]); B2 cis→drive [F] data-blocked (not [L]); B1 [L]; O1 [L]; O2 [L]; O3 [F]+[V]; quorum gate [V]; B3 absolute strength & origin of rates are firewall ceilings; a built/simulated human [O]. No body is claimed; physical_complete=False (the binding criterion requires B2 AND B4 both [L], and B2 is data-blocked). Gate PASS 18/18. The blueprint is now FULLY MAPPED — every open question resolved into closed, ceiling, data-blocked with the gap named, or declared scope; the README carries §INHERIT and the fully-mapped BLUEPRINT.
